name: pad_truncate
description: Composable width primitives: pad_left/right/center and truncate_ellipsis/middle. These are visual-width aware (count display columns, not bytes) and ANSI-safe (never cut a colour code; re-emit RESET after a truncation that opened a style).

cases.name: pad_right pads with trailing spaces to the target width
pad_left right-aligns by padding on the left
pad_center splits the slack (extra column biases right)
pad_* never truncates — already wide enough is returned unchanged
truncate_ellipsis drops the tail and appends the default ellipsis
truncate_ellipsis with a custom multi-char ellipsis
truncate_ellipsis at width == ellipsis width yields just the ellipsis
truncate_ellipsis at width 0 yields the empty string (no ellipsis, no panic)
truncate_ellipsis preserves an open ANSI style and closes it after the ellipsis
truncate_middle keeps both ends, ellipsis in the middle (left-biased on odd)
truncate_middle on a path keeps the head and the basename
